UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private profile document for an authenticated student syncing learning progress.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

displayName.description: Student display name shown in the account menu.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

JourneyProgress.title: JourneyProgress
JourneyProgress.description: Tracks the student's current Lernreise stage index and completed mini-check IDs.

stageIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current Lernreise stage (0 to 20).

completedCheckIds.description: Bounded list (max 50) of completed Mini-Check identifiers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when progress tracking started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress update.

QuizItemProgress.title: QuizItemProgress
QuizItemProgress.description: Per-question and per-flashcard mastery counters for the Karten & Quiz trainer.

itemId.description: Normalized quiz or flashcard item identifier matching document ID.

rightCount.description: Number of times answered correctly (0 to 10000).

wrongCount.description: Number of times answered incorrectly (0 to 10000).

lastResult.description: Most recent outcome: 1 for correct, 0 for incorrect.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this quiz item was first answered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest answer.

/users/{userId}.description: Private root document per authenticated student.

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Lernreise progress document (document ID 'journey') owned by the parent user.

/users/{userId}/quizItems/{itemId}.description: Individual flashcard and multiple-choice mastery records owned by the parent user.
